Elena — great to hear the demo landed well. Short answer: yes, we can support an extension and we have two pragmatic options depending on how much control you need over the environment.

Option A — Time-limited extension (no discount):
- Extend the pilot by up to 3 weeks at the same trial terms (free evaluation nodes remain the same).
- No change to billing; if you convert to a paid pilot we’ll apply standard onboarding fees.

Option B — Discounted paid pilot (recommended if you want dedicated support & SLAs):
- 6-week paid pilot priced at 40% of list for the pilot period.
- Includes 2 dedicated support hours/week and one architecture review.
- Requires signed pilot SOW and a small one-time setup fee.

I’m attaching a short spreadsheet with pricing permutations (POC_pricing_v3.xlsx) and a mutual action plan template (pilot_mtap_v1.docx). If you prefer Option B I’ll need to loop Ava (cc’d) to confirm discount authority and Karthik to confirm finance acceptance.

Next steps: tell me which option you prefer and we’ll push a redline SOW or calendar the extra time.

— Ben
